result.title: Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. To enable efficient long-term streaming reasoning, we present EviStream, a training-free causal visual memory mechanism that preserves reasoning-critical evidence under a fixed KV budget. Experiments reveal substantial gaps between current VLMs and realistic streaming requirements, establishing StreamRecall as a foundation for developing evidence-aware streaming video intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 StreamRecall，一个面向流式视频问答的上下文感知多证据推理基准，含 4,983 个问题与细粒度时序证据标注，并设计「证据利用级联」诊断流程与免训练的因果视觉记忆机制 EviStream。
AI.relevance_reason: 其固定 KV 预算下保留推理关键证据的记忆机制、证据定位/链条完成的诊断环节，以及「在合适时机作答」的设定，可为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、内部状态保留与停止决策提供可核查的评测线索。
